info.name: NetworkManagementClient LoadBalancers VirtualNetworks API
info.description: The Microsoft Azure Network management API provides a RESTful set of web services that interact with Microsoft Azure Networks service to manage your network resources. The API has entities that capture the relationship between an end user and the Microsoft Azure Networks service.

item.name: Azure Networking Services Virtual Networks_ List All

variable.description: (Required) The subscription credentials which uniquely identify the Microsoft Azure subscription. The subscription ID forms part of the URI for every service call.

request.description: Gets all virtual networks in a subscription.

response.name: Request successful. The operation returns a list of VirtualNetwork resources.

header.description: Added as a part of security scheme: oauth2
